o.text: From Proto-Turkic *bïŋ (“thousand”). Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰉𐰃𐰭 (bïŋ), 𐰋𐰃𐰭 (biŋ), Old Uyghur 𐽹𐽶𐽺𐽷 (mïŋ, “thousand”), Turkish bin (“thousand”), Bashkir мең (miñ, “thousand”), etc.
From Proto-Turkic *barmak. Cognate with Turkish parmak, etc.
Morphologically from qır- (“to break off, destroy, etc”) + -ğın. Cognate with Turkmen gyrgyn.
Internationalism; from Russian капитуля́ция (kapituljácija), from Polish kapitulacja, from Medieval Latin capitulatio.
